stories.headline: Major websites begin blocking AI agents from accessing services
stories.summary: Services like Yelp, Delta Air Lines, and JPMorgan Chase are now blocking AI agents from performing tasks such as booking tickets or checking accounts. This limits the capabilities of autonomous agents designed to handle online errands for users.
stories.whyItMatters: The pushback from major service providers highlights growing security and access friction as autonomous AI agents attempt to interact with consumer platforms.

stories.headline: RapidCanvas raises $29M in Series B funding to build enterprise AI applications
stories.summary: Austin-based startup RapidCanvas has secured $29M in Series B funding to develop and run AI applications for businesses. The company pairs its AI agent platform with human engineers and plans to expand its hiring across the US, Brazil, and India.
stories.whyItMatters: Venture investment continues to flow into platforms that combine automated AI agents with human engineering support for enterprise workflows.

stories.headline: Self Labs launches Agent Vault to manage AI agent account access
stories.summary: Self Labs has released Agent Vault, a service designed to allow AI agents to securely log into user accounts. The launch addresses emerging access and security challenges as major platforms begin blocking automated agent traffic.
stories.whyItMatters: Secure authentication infrastructure is becoming necessary as developers build autonomous agents that require access to personal and financial accounts.

stories.headline: Nature Will launches Natura-1 foundation model for robotics
stories.summary: Nature Will has released Natura-1, a 50-billion-parameter model built for dexterous hand control and instruction following in robotics. The model was pre-trained on over one million hours of human data to map language instructions directly to physical actions.
stories.whyItMatters: Large foundation models trained on extensive human physical data help bridge the gap between high-level language commands and fine-grained robotic manipulation.

stories.headline: Microsoft and NVIDIA publish guide on managing open-weight model risk
stories.summary: Microsoft and NVIDIA released a joint whitepaper that outlines a risk taxonomy and recommendations for enterprises deploying open-weight AI models. The guide aligns its advice with standards such as ISO and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
stories.whyItMatters: It helps organizations assess and mitigate potential risks when using open-weight models, promoting safer AI deployment.
